scope.coverage: positive-only, including windows marked checked; omissions never establish absence
scope.occurrence: events include only owner-confirmed performed acts
scope.otherActivity: other confirmed performed categories are retained with scored:false
scope.context: memory, imagined, habitual, recording and not-performed confirmations remain in reviews, not performed events
scope.rejected: wrong and uncertain proposals remain in reviews and never become positives
scope.hints: unreviewed; never derive negative hint labels or per-hit labels from act reviews
scope.confidenceTraining: none; only separately imported main engine verdicts train confidence
scope.privateText: free-text context, story text and assistant confidence are excluded
